# Overview and Deliverables

* 9/14: Attend the course meetup at 8:00PM Eastern
* [Story 2](../assignments/stories/tbd.qmd) is assigned this week and due Sunday 9/27 (end of week 4)

This week we will focus on distinguishing the bad and the ugly from a high quality data visualization. We will also learn some basic graphic design principles and learn about the differences between
different image formats.

### Readings

1. __Wilke__ - Chapters 17-26 - there will be some reinforcement of the research principles we discussed last week
2. [__Contrast, Repetition, Alignment, Proximity__ - Chapter 6 of Presentation Zen by Garr Reynolds](readings/Chapter6-spread.pdf)
3. [Guide to File Formats](https://theglowstudio.com/file-formats-explained/)

### Meetup

Slides: [Meetup 3 - Visualization Quality and Graphic Design](../meetups/meetup-3/meetup-3-slides.qmd)

In this meetup we go into a bit of detail on several principles that Edward Tufte articulated and discuss how to implement them in real visualizations. We talk about the principle of proportional ink and the data-ink ratio, and why minimalist graphs don't always work.
